title: Combat: Tactic
description: Use this oracle to help inspire an action for an NPC in combat. When you're not sure what your foe does next, particularly when they have initiative, roll on this table and interpret the result as appropriate to the situation.
postamble:
Use the Combat Event oracles to answer questions about the actions of a foe or enemy force. You can use these oracles instead of—or in addition to—the Combat: Tactic oracle.
Roll once each on the Combat: Event Method oracle and the Combat: Event Target oracle. Then, interpret the response as appropriate to the current situation and the nature of your foe.
_For example, you are fighting a Rhaskar, a bear-like beast. It has initiative, and you want to know what it does next. You Ask the Oracle, rolling Event Method and Event Target. The oracle responds, “Await Weakness.” You envision the Rhaskar circling you, its keen eyes narrowing as it looks for an opening in your defences. You must Face Danger to avoid being outmaneuvered._

data.value: Shift focus to someone or something else.
Destroy something, or render it useless.
Use the terrain to gain advantage.
Leverage the advantage of a weapon or ability.
